mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a comfortable temperature of 62 degrees and a Waning Gibbous moon visible overhead.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that they can now process records and crash reports through crashdocs.org. Please keep in mind that redactions for personal information may cause a delay of up to 10 business days for record requests.

We have plenty of fun on the horizon. Start today with Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow features trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Downtown Farmer's Market and live music later this week.
In a noteworthy call from July 21, a Verona Police drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in a search for an individual who fled a residence.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM.
